# cloudaxion_load_balancer (Resource)

A layer 4 network load balancer.

~> **TCP only.** The API offers no HTTP mode, no TLS termination and no health checks. In a Kubernetes cell this is the plain front door: terminate TLS in-cluster (Envoy Gateway or similar) and point the load balancer at the ingress node ports.

Rules and targets are declared inline and reconciled against the API on update.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Layer 4 only: TLS terminates in-cluster, this is the front door.
resource "cloudaxion_load_balancer" "ingress" {
  name       = "ingress"
  network_id = cloudaxion_private_network.cluster.id

  rule {
    source_port = 443
    target_port = 30443 # ingress controller node port
  }

  rule {
    source_port = 80
    target_port = 30080
  }

  target {
    id = cloudaxion_vm.node.id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `billing_account_id` (Number) Billing account. Defaults to the provider's `billing_account_id`.
- `location` (String) Location slug. Defaults to the provider's `location`.
- `network_id` (String) Private network the load balancer sits in.
- `reserve_public_ip` (Boolean) Whether to reserve a public address for the load balancer. On import this is inferred from whether `public_address` is set, since the API does not report the original request.
- `rule` (Block List) A TCP port mapping from the load balancer to its targets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule))
- `target` (Block List) A backend behind the load balancer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--target))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp reported by the API.
- `id` (String) Load balancer UUID.
- `private_address` (String) Address of the load balancer on its private network.
- `public_address` (String) Public address, when one is reserved.

<a id="nestedblock--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `source_port` (Number) Port the load balancer listens on.
- `target_port` (Number) Port on the targets to forward to.

Read-Only:

- `uuid` (String) Rule UUID. Assigned by the API and only visible after a read — creating a rule does not return it.


<a id="nestedblock--target"></a>
### Nested Schema for `target`

Required:

- `id` (String) UUID of the backend, normally a virtual machine.

Optional:

- `type` (String) Backend kind. `vm` is the only documented value.

Read-Only:

- `ip_address` (String) Private address of the backend.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cloudaxion_load_balancer.ingress tun01/72bfe60d-730b-438b-ae8a-b7a0409b5186
```
